reviews.text: This is my favourite everyday moisturiser. I have combination skin and this cream feels amazing. It doesn't get my skin oily at all and it feels like it is actually adding moisture. Love the watery like texture and a tiny bit goes a long way. Makes my skin feels amazing. I actually use the whole line and my skin feels smooth and healthier. I even had compliments about it.
reviews.zh: 呢款係我最愛嘅日常保濕霜。我嘅皮膚係混合性，用呢款面霜感覺好好。佢完全唔會令我皮膚出油，而且感覺真係有加入水分。我好鍾意佢水狀嘅質地，只需要一少點就夠。佢令我皮膚感覺好好。我其實用晒成個系列，我嘅皮膚感覺更滑、更健康。仲有人稱讚過我。

reviews.text: I've repurchased this face cream a couple of times now cause I just love it. Many face creams either break me out or don't seem to do much, but this one makes my skin feel moisturized without blocking my pores. It also has a brightening effect, and I've noticed some of my acne scars have started to fade. I will definitely keep using this one in future.
reviews.zh: 我已經回購咗呢款面霜幾次，因為我真係好鍾意。好多面霜唔係令我爆痘，就係好似冇乜效用，但呢款令我皮膚保濕，又唔會堵塞毛孔。佢仲有提亮效果，而且我留意到部分痘印開始淡咗。我以後一定會繼續用呢款。

reviews.text: I've started in November and it's mid March, so 4.5 months and I still have a bit left. This is from using it twice a day. The consistency is just as you imagine what snail cream is like, gloopy and slimy. When applied it's very light weight and quickly absorbed into skin, which gives you a nice glow. Truly recommend it for any skin type (I'm acne prone and combo). Gives you a nice hydration and helps sooth the acne.
reviews.zh: 我由十一月開始用，而家已經三月中，即係用咗四個半月，仲剩返一啲。呢個係我每日用兩次嘅結果。質地正如你所想像嘅蝸牛面霜，黏稠、滑溜。搽上皮膚時好輕，好快就吸收入皮膚，令皮膚有好靚嘅光澤感。真心推薦畀任何膚質（我易生暗瘡，屬混合性皮膚）。佢提供好好嘅保濕，亦有助舒緩暗瘡。

reviews.text:
I was really surprised by it. I tried a few other products from the brand and they never disappointed so far so why not.
first of all I expected like a thick cream but it was more lotion like feeling. I was a bit scarred that it wouldn't be enough moisturizing throughout the night but the minute I applied it , I LOVED IT. it's very soft and not sticky and absorbs so well. my face looked very nice and healthy after applying it. and when I woke up I still was very hydrated and soft feel to my skin. I only been using it for a few days so I can't tell any benefits in the long term but at this point I really recommend it. I have a more oily skinn but also sometimes dry especially since winter has started🙈 and it does the trick without feeling greasy. I think it works for nightcream aswell as a daycream.
reviews.zh:
我真係好驚喜。我之前試過呢個品牌嘅其他產品，佢哋到目前都冇令我失望，所以點解唔試吓呢款呢？
首先，我本來以為係厚身面霜，但感覺更似乳液。我有啲擔心佢喺成晚都保濕唔夠，但係我一搽上去就好鍾意。佢好軟、唔黏，吸收得好好。搽完之後，我個面睇落好靚、好健康。而醒嚟嗰陣，我嘅皮膚仍然好水潤、好軟滑。我只係用咗幾日，所以唔知長遠有咩效果，但係到目前為止，我真係推薦。我嘅皮膚偏油性，但係冬天開始之後有時都會乾，佢都可以搞定，又唔會覺得油膩。我覺得佢可以做晚霜，亦可以做日霜。🙈

reviews.text:
I like the texture of this cream, it reminds me of a certain steam cream I used in the past. A very little goes a long way, specially if you use the whole line. It's not dense, but light and not greasy. It has a botanic scent, I like it but maybe could be too much for very sensitive people.
Packed with the loveliest working ingredients snail, centella, loads of ceramides among some others.
I can't tell about the effects because my skin is in perfect conditions at the moment. Must be the good decisions I'm taking concerning skincare.
reviews.zh:
我鍾意呢款面霜嘅質地，令我諗起我以前用過嘅某款 steam cream。只需要一少點就好夠，特別係如果你用晒成個系列。佢唔係好稠，而係輕盈、唔油膩。佢有植物香味，我鍾意，但對於好敏感嘅人嚟講可能會太濃。
佢含有好多好有效嘅成分，例如蝸牛、積雪草，仲有大量神經醯胺，以及其他成分。
我講唔到效果，因為我嘅皮膚而家好好。一定係因為我近日對護膚嘅決定做得好啱。

reviews.text: I have a very sensitive and demanding skin. As soon as I'm stressed my skin show immediately the result. And I tried a lot of several creams. But this is the first one where I can really say that it works. I use this cream together with the cleanser, toner and serum since over three month now. And my skin is much better. Of course it needs a little time to see the first results. But it really works and I can highly recommend it. To get results I use this series as my night treatment.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚非常敏感，而且好難照顧。一有壓力，皮膚即刻就會反映出嚟。我試過好多款面霜，但呢款係第一款我真係可以話有效嘅產品。我用呢款面霜，配埋潔面、爽膚水同精華，已經超過三個月。我嘅皮膚好咗好多。當然要等一段時間先見到首批效果。但係佢真係有效，我非常推薦。為咗見到效果，我會將呢套系列用作晚間護理。

reviews.text: There weren't major differences during the first couple weeks I used this product, but I could see little increment improvement in the texture of my skin. I use it after serum and before moisturiser (because my skin have become super dry). It brightens and fades my acne scars which is really nice; it was hard for me to find such product.
reviews.zh: 我用呢款產品頭幾個禮拜都冇咩大分別，但係我見到皮膚質地有少少逐步改善。我係精華之後、保濕霜之前用（因為我嘅皮膚已經好乾）。佢可以提亮同淡化暗瘡疤痕，好好，我以前好難搵到咁嘅產品。

reviews.text: Had troubles for a long time trying to find a moisturizer suitable for my skin, even if it was recommended for my exact skin type, it always felt too greasy after some time, or not enough hydration, some even felt like somehow worsened the irritation of my acne. But this one is just perfect!! Hydrates my skin beautifully, soothing my skin in general and helping with the acne, feels amazing, not greasy at all and still makes my skin feel supple and plumped.
reviews.zh: 我好耐以嚟都搵唔到啱我皮膚嘅保濕霜，即使有人推薦啱我呢種皮膚類型，用咗一段時間都會覺得太油，或者保濕唔夠，有啲甚至令我嘅暗瘡更加刺激。但呢款真係完美！！保濕效果好好，整體都舒緩我嘅皮膚，對暗瘡都有幫助，感覺好好，一啲都唔油膩，而且令皮膚仍然柔潤飽滿。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
